No security findings or security follow-ups. Prior authentication and
privacy conclusions carry forward after review of the complete four-file
delta (+138/-63).

Security evidence:

- crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:609-615,642 constructs the counter table
  from Endpoint::ALL paths. route_counts.rs:87-93,115-131 sorts and
  deduplicates static templates into a fixed boxed slice with inline
  counters. No request-derived label is inserted.
- route_counts.rs:134-159 only searches the table; missing or unknown
  templates increment unmatched without allocating or expanding storage.
  :35-57,163-196 emits fixed method names, table templates and unmatched.
  Bounds remain 62 templates, eight method buckets, one unmatched bucket,
  and 128 query-shape slots. Key bytes remain application-controlled.
- route_counts.rs:67-77,163-196 reads independent atomics; each emitted
  count is reused in the wrapping total. Snapshot nontransactionality and
  u64 wrapping are documented diagnostics, not authorization decisions.
  :201-259 retains fixed-vocabulary query shapes and MatchedPath, not raw
  paths, query values, tokens, seat IDs or captured job IDs.
- http/mod.rs:792-851 preserves bearer middleware, the separately
  authenticated job-token route and outer counting layer.
  route_counts.rs:237-259 still delegates to guarded handlers and returns
  responses unchanged. Authentication has no delta.

Cost:

The earlier recording mutex/map lookup is removed. Recording now performs
a binary search and atomic outcome increment, with no recording mutex,
per-path Arc clone or first-request allocation. GET /v1/seats retains a
query-byte scan and second increment; the existing MatchedPath middleware
clone is unchanged. No new production background loop, poll, timer,
process launch, logging or store write; no per-seat scaling. This is a
security PASS, not the separate performance role's live-cost verdict.
